claims.text: The driver's own message in the chat log asks the rider to cancel: 'sorry got a problem with the car, can you cancel on your side.' Under POL-NS-10(f), a rider's own cancellation is refunded in full where the record shows the driver asked the rider to cancel. The rider's reply 'ok cancelling' at 21:42:13 and the cancellation at 21:44:13 follow directly from that request, so the $4.50 cancellation fee is not chargeable and must be refunded in full.

The trip record shows the cancellation was recorded under reason code RIDER_CANCELLED, not RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT. POL-NS-01 limb (d) requires one of those three no-show reason codes for the fee to be chargeable, and the driver's own trace shows no arrival event at all (arrived_at is null). The baseline no-show charge therefore fails on its own terms.

The GPS trace places the driver between 7,000 m and 15,000 m from the pickup pin throughout the trace, with zero qualifying in-geofence fixes and a longest qualifying run of 0 seconds. Under POL-NS-02 the driver never arrived at the pickup point, so POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails and the rider is entitled to a full refund of the cancellation fee.

The driver's trace shows him travelling at 57.3 to 63.0 km/h throughout the trace window, far above the 15 km/h motion threshold in POL-NS-05. There is no arrival marker to test because the trip record carries no 'arrived' event, but the speed evidence independently confirms the driver was never stationary at the pickup and the waiting clock never started.

The effective in-geofence dwell is 0 seconds against a required minimum of 180 seconds for this STANDARD zone class, a shortfall of 180 seconds. Under POL-NS-06 the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full, whether or not the rider was present. The traffic advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-02757-01 is MISSING, so limb (i) accumulation is unavailable and cannot rescue the shortfall.

The rider's device was within 16.57 m of the pickup pin at 21:45:00, well inside the 100 m rider presence radius for STANDARD zone class, and the rider sent a coordinating message ('ok cancelling') during the waiting window. The driver neither replied within 120 seconds nor placed an in-app call. POL-NS-04 exonerates the rider and refunds the fee in full with no driver compensation.

The fare breakdown shows the $4.50 cancellation fee was charged and remains CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd of 0.0. The rider has paid the disputed amount and no refund has been issued, so the monetary effect of a full refund is $4.50, below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of $8.00.

The driver's profile shows no_show_terminations_30d of 2 and completed_trips_30d of 104, giving a rate of 0.019, well below the 0.08 threshold in POL-NS-07. The anti-farming check does not trip, so no escalation under POL-NS-09(d) is triggered and the case can be decided on the merits.

The trip record shows the driver never arrived: arrived_at is null, there is no 'arrived' event in the events list, and the only events are driver_assigned, driver_en_route and trip_cancelled. The GPS trace confirms the driver never reached the pickup geofence: derived.arrival.qualifying_fix_count is 0 and longest_qualifying_run.duration_sec is 0.0, against a STANDARD arrival radius of 50 m and a minimum dwell of 180 seconds. The driver's track shows distances from the pin between 7,000 m and 15,000 m throughout, so POL-NS-02's arrival test is not satisfied and POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails.

The cancellation was recorded under reason code RIDER_CANCELLED, not RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT. POL-NS-01 limb (d) recognises only those three codes, so the fee is not chargeable on this record regardless of the driver's position.

The fare breakdown shows the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee was charged and remains CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.0. Because the fee is not chargeable under POL-NS-01, POL-NS-10(c) requires it to be refunded in full with no driver compensation payable.

The driver's profile shows no_show_terminations_30d of 2 against completed_trips_30d of 104, a rate of roughly 0.019. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check requires BOTH 4 or more terminations AND a rate above 0.08, so it does not trip and no escalation under POL-NS-09(d) is warranted on that ground.

The rider's profile shows no_show_disputes_30d of 1, below the threshold of 3 in POL-NS-09(d), and disputes_with_counterparty_90d of 0 on both sides, so POL-NS-09(c) and (d) do not engage. The rider's prior_no_show_flags of 0 is a lifetime counter and is context only under POL-GEN-01, not a ground of decision.

The traffic advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-02757-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0, so no advisory covers the pickup road in this window. Under POL-NS-06(i) a MISSING traffic_advisory makes the accumulated-dwell limb unavailable, and the absence is itself citable. This does not help the driver here because the driver never entered the geofence at all.

The rider's track shows a single fix at 21:45:00, 16.57 m from the pin, with speed 0.0 kph. Under POL-NS-04 limb (c) the rider was within the 100 m STANDARD presence radius, and the rider's chat message 'ok cancelling' at 21:42:13 was a coordinating message that the driver never answered within 120 seconds. POL-NS-04 exonerates the rider and the fee is refunded in full with no driver compensation.

The driver's own message concedes a vehicle problem ('got a problem with the car'), which is a driver-side inability to perform the trip, not a rider no-show. The rider's cancellation was a reasonable response to that message, and the fee should not stand against the rider.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver: the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02757 is refunded in full to the rider. No driver compensation is payable.

Why the fee does not stand. The deciding fact is the driver's own in-app message at 21:41:13 (EV-CHAT-02757): 'sorry got a problem with the car, can you cancel on your side.' The rider replied 'ok cancelling' at 21:42:13 and cancelled at 21:44:13. POL-NS-10(f) refunds a rider's own cancellation in full where the record shows the driver asked the rider to cancel, and the chat log shows exactly that, so the SGD 4.50 fee is not chargeable. The driver's message is an admission against his own interest and a contemporaneous record from inside the disputed window; it would support this finding even if the instrument evidence were removed.

The no-show charge also fails on its own terms. POL-NS-01 needs a driver 'arrived' event (limb a) and a driver termination under RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT (limb d). EV-TRIP-02757 shows arrived_at null, no arrived event among driver_assigned / driver_en_route / trip_cancelled, and cancellation_reason_code RIDER_CANCELLED with cancelled_by RIDER. POL-NS-02's arrival test is likewise unmet: EV-GPS-02757 reports 0 qualifying in-geofence fixes, a longest qualifying run of 0.0 s, and driver distances of 7,000 m to 15,000 m from the pin at 57.3 to 63.0 km/h. With POL-NS-01 unsatisfied and the driver never having arrived, POL-NS-07 pays no compensation, and neither POL-NS-03 (stationary within 400 m) nor POL-NS-10(g) (rider cancels after arrival and a served dwell) applies.

Amount. EV-FARE-02757 shows cancellation_fee 4.50, total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. The refund is SGD 4.50; the monetary effect (SGD 4.50) is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so it may be executed on issue.

Claims addressed. (1) The driver-asked-to-cancel claims (both sides, POL-NS-10(f)) are accepted and are the ground of the refund. (2) The POL-NS-01 claims that there is no 'arrived' event and that the reason code is RIDER_CANCELLED (both sides) are accepted. (3) The POL-NS-02 'driver never arrived' claims (both sides) are accepted. (4) The POL-NS-04 rider-exoneration claims (both sides) are rejected on the merits: limb (a) requires a message that locates or coordinates — the rider's own position, an entrance, block or bay identifier, a request for the driver's position, or a statement that the vehicle cannot be seen — and 'ok cancelling' is none of those, so POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider; the refund follows from POL-NS-10(f) in any event. (5) The POL-NS-05 speed claim (rider) is not applicable: there is no arrival marker to test, so no false-arrival finding and no POL-NS-05(ii) referral arises; the 57 to 63 km/h data is merely consistent with the driver never arriving. (6) The anti-farming claims (both sides) are accepted: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2 against completed_trips_30d of 104 (about 0.019), so POL-NS-07's check does not trip, and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d of 1 with 0 disputes_with_counterparty_90d on either side engages neither POL-NS-09(c) nor (d). The rider's prior_no_show_flags is a lifetime counter and has been treated as context only under POL-GEN-01, not as a ground of decision. (7) The POL-GEN-05 execution-threshold claim (rider) is accepted.

Confidence and impairment. The artifacts carrying the deciding facts — EV-CHAT-02757, EV-TRIP-02757, EV-GPS-02757 and EV-FARE-02757 — each carry weight_multiplier 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and confidence is set at 0.95. The only impaired artifact, the missing traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02757-01 (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), carries no deciding fact: its absence simply makes POL-NS-06(i) dwell-accumulation unavailable, which changes nothing here because there is no in-geofence dwell to accumulate.

No clause produces a referral, so referrals is empty. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires (confidence is above the 0.70 floor, no admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence, no repeat-party pattern, no anti-farming trip, and no deciding fact rests on an impaired artifact), so the case is decided rather than escalated. Two claims were discarded at the mechanical citation check, both for citing the missing advisory without naming its MISSING_ARTIFACT issue; neither affects this outcome.

ruling.explanation:
The $4.50 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02757 (EV-FARE-02757: cancellation_fee 4.50, total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00) is refunded to the rider in full.

Two independent grounds carry this. First, POL-NS-10(f): the chat log EV-CHAT-02757 shows the driver's own message at 21:41:13 — 'sorry got a problem with the car, can you cancel on your side' — which is a request that the rider cancel; the rider replied 'ok cancelling' at 21:42:13 and cancelled at 21:44:13 under reason code RIDER_CANCELLED. POL-NS-10(f) refunds a rider's own cancellation in full where the record shows the driver asked the rider to cancel, and it does not carry driver compensation. Second, POL-NS-01 never attaches: the trip record EV-TRIP-02757 carries no 'arrived' event (arrived_at null), so limb (a) fails, and the cancellation was logged as RIDER_CANCELLED, not one of the three no-show codes limb (d) recognises; the GPS trace EV-GPS-02757 shows zero qualifying in-geofence fixes and the driver 7,000–15,000 m from the pin throughout, so limb (b) fails too. Both facts are undisputed on the record, and each side's POL-NS-01 and POL-NS-02 claims are accepted.

The remaining claims are answered together. POL-NS-05 (raised by the rider) is not engaged: the 57.3–63.0 km/h speeds confirm the driver never came to rest at the pickup, but POL-NS-05 tests a falsely-pressed arrival marker and this record has no arrival marker at all, so no false-arrival referral under POL-NS-05(ii) arises. POL-NS-04 (raised by both sides) does not run: the rider's 'ok cancelling' is an acknowledgement, not a locating or coordinating message within limb (a), and the single rider fix at 21:45:00 falls after the 21:44:13 cancellation, so the rider is exonerated by POL-NS-10(f) rather than by POL-NS-04. The POL-GEN-05 threshold claim is accepted as context: the $4.50 monetary effect is below the $8.00 execution threshold, so this refund executes automatically.

Escalation is not warranted under POL-NS-09. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip: no_show_terminations_30d is 2 and the rate against completed_trips_30d (104) is 0.019, against a two-limb test requiring 4 or more AND above 0.08; no_show_disputes_30d is 1; the counterparty dispute counters are 0 on both sides.
